   `let routePickView: "location" | "distance"` 단일 상태. 초기값은
   `pins.start && (distanceDirectionChecked || autoSessionActive) ? "distance" : "location"`.
   신규 식별자는 route 계열(`routePickView/routeLocationView/routeDistanceHead·BackBtn·Title·
